description: This PHP source file manages the UI and backend logic for configuring Wi-Fi Protected Setup (WPS) on a wireless network device. It includes logic to enable/disable WPS, select pairing methods, and handle user interactions for adding a Wi-Fi client via WPS.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates the checksum of a WPS PIN code to ensure correctness before attempting to connect.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Prepares and sends WPS configuration data via AJAX to the server, handling user-initiated WPS connection actions.
